## Constants
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/percentage/contracts/BPS.sol)

#### BPS_FACTOR
These operators allow for intuitive arithmetic and comparison operations
on BPS values

Overridden operators declaration for BPS

The denominator for basis-point arithmetic — represents 100%


```solidity
uint256 constant BPS_FACTOR = 10_000
```

#### BPS_100
BPS value representing 100%


```solidity
BPS constant BPS_100 = BPS.wrap(BPS_FACTOR)
```

#### BPS_1
BPS value representing 1 basis point (0.01%)


```solidity
BPS constant BPS_1 = BPS.wrap(1)
```



## BPS
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/percentage/contracts/BPS.sol)

**Title:**
BPS

**Author:**
Roberto Cano

Custom type for Basis Points values with associated utility functions

This type is used to represent basis-point values (0 – 10000)

This contract defines a custom BPS type and overloaded operators to perform
arithmetic and comparison operations on BPS values.
1 BPS = 0.01%
100 BPS = 1%
10000 BPS = 100%
Because the unit is already the native scale there is no internal decimal
factor beyond `BPS_FACTOR` itself, which makes constants trivial to declare:
BPS constant MAX_SLIPPAGE = BPS.wrap(500); // 5%

Custom basis-points type as uint256


```solidity
type BPS is uint256
```
